_comment: Documented exceptions for the axe-core gate (a11y.mjs). Each names an axe rule, a CSS selector for the elements it covers, the reason, and when it was added. Remove an entry as soon as its cause is fixed upstream.

exceptions.reason: Plugin 1.3.0 gives every inlined diagram role=img, so a clickable diagram's links count as interactive content nested in an image. Readers using assistive technology reach the same links in the list that follows every diagram (DEC-036, DEC-051). Remove when the plugin gives a diagram with links another role.
